target_statement: for every t in Q with t>1, U_t(Q)=empty for the exact smooth diagonal genus-5 fiber C_t

sources.role: exact structural and fixed/function-field arithmetic method

B1_FIXED_FIBER_DIAGONAL_G5_COVERING_CHAB.method: five elliptic quotients, 2-descent/covering collections, elliptic-curve Chabauty
B1_FIXED_FIBER_DIAGONAL_G5_COVERING_CHAB.what_it_can_prove: complete C_t(Q) for an individual t when the required MW/Selmer/rank hypotheses and computations are certified
B1_FIXED_FIBER_DIAGONAL_G5_COVERING_CHAB.failure: running or proving the method fiber by fiber does not quantify over all rational t>1

B2_FUNCTION_FIELD_MW_AND_GENERIC_SECTION.method: determine elliptic quotient groups over Q(t) using full rational 2-torsion and injective specialization, then constrain C(Q(t))
B2_FUNCTION_FIELD_MW_AND_GENERIC_SECTION.failure: C(Q(t)) does not contain rational points that exist only after specialization; E(Q(t))->E_tau(Q) injectivity is not surjectivity

B3_SILVERMAN_OR_GUSIC_TADIC_STYLE_SPECIA.what_it_can_prove: injectivity of the generic MW group into suitable or sufficiently large-height specializations
B3_SILVERMAN_OR_GUSIC_TADIC_STYLE_SPECIA.failure: injectivity preserves generic points but does not exclude new specialized MW points or new C_tau(Q) points

B4_GENERIC_FALTINGS_FINITE_PER_FIBER.what_it_can_prove: each fixed smooth genus-5 fiber has finitely many rational points
B4_GENERIC_FALTINGS_FINITE_PER_FIBER.failure: non-effective/fiberwise finiteness gives neither emptiness nor a uniform exhaustive reduction over all t

B5_RECEIVER_RESTRICTED_INTERSECTION_OBST.potential: a uniform local/global obstruction on the exact physical-open intersection could close T35-R3-PHYS-EMPTY without classifying every C_t(Q)
B5_RECEIVER_RESTRICTED_INTERSECTION_OBST.current_input: no exact prime/residue/torsor obstruction valid for every rational t>1 is presently source-locked

B6_UNIFORM_SPECIALIZATION_NEW_POINT_CONT.needed: a theorem excluding specialization-new physical rational points on every C_t or on a proof-capable elliptic/cover quotient for all rational t>1

targeted_literature_scan.later_specialization_algorithm_direction: available literature located for injectivity of specialization maps, not uniform surjectivity/exclusion of new specialized points

sharpened_class3_wall.old: uniform arithmetic/specialization theorem over a moving genus-3/genus-5 family
sharpened_class3_wall.new: for the single exact Q-defined smooth diagonal genus-5 family TS-S-R3-Q1, uniformly exclude specialization-new rational points in the physical open for every t in Q>1, or prove a receiver-restricted obstruction with the same quantifier
